task: Hearth & Horizon: a revision pass on 'Joined at Ten Past Five', after a duplicate story on the same proposal was dropped
errors: Wrote a full 5,500-word story ('Make the Last Joint Cold') on the PE-pipe proposal while PR #16213 was landing a story on the same proposal. The draft was dropped as a duplicate. It is kept only in the session scratchpad.

doc_friction.issue: The duplicate check searches open PRs by title. PR #16213 was titled as a multiple-comparisons story when checked, and later landed the pipe story, so a title search missed it. Checking the open PRs' changed files, or re-reading BIBLE.md on origin/main just before drafting, would have caught it.
Named For Other Minds as due, though its only proposal was already taken by open PRs. It does not read open PRs.

deviations.why: A new story is the default deliverable, but the finished draft duplicated a story merged minutes earlier (same proposal, same province, same cemetery and plumber).
deviations.did: Dropped the draft. Shipped a revision pass on the merged story (4 slips against its note), a numeric check of 'Toss It Again' (clean), and a replacement for a bible proposal that duplicated 'The Iron Bridge at Forty-Two'.
deviations.result: Merged. The shelf has no duplicate story, and the merged story's numbers now agree with its note.

notes: Project: hearth-and-horizon. Piece: joined-at-ten-past-five (revision). Slips fixed: the note's cold-joint delta-T (9 K should be 12 K), 'ten times' steel (should be fifteen), July slip 'two centimetres' (now 'a centimetre or two'; the model's middle value is 15 mm), and Thursday 18:00 called dark (civil dusk ends 18:24; moved to seven). toss-it-again: z-tests, Bonferroni, Holm and BH lines recomputed, no slips.
